description:
Settle a proposal and, if it passed, pay the proposer. Permissionless — anyone may call it, and someone must. Conclude opens the moment voting closes.

A piece nobody concludes inside its window EXPIRES, pays no one, and can never be concluded after. Concluding late pays what concluding early would; the payout was snapshotted at propose time.

Requires an unlocked wallet — caller pays gas, proposer gets the payout.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
name: legion_conclude
